title: Head of Product Payments (f/m/d)
description:
We are looking for a Head of Product to lead our payments product organisation.

What you'll do
- Lead a team of eight product managers and product owners
- Own the payments strategy and annual planning with the CEO and CTO
- Represent product in regulator and partner discussions

What you bring
- 10+ years in product, of which 5 in leadership roles
- Proven record of scaling payment products
- Excellent English
